name: CG Power and Industrial Solutions Ltd
tagline: Excellent-quality electrical equipment maker, but already an Rs 1.36 lakh Cr mega-cap -- far too large for a 10x-in-2-3-years thesis regardless of quality
business_overview: CG Power manufactures electrical equipment (transformers, motors, switchgear) and industrial systems. The company underwent a major governance crisis in 2019-2020 (an Avantha Group-era related-party fraud) before being restructured under new ownership led by the Murugappa Group (via Tube Investments), and has since executed a genuine operational turnaround.
fundamentals_narrative: The fundamentals are genuinely excellent by every conventional quality measure -- ROCE in the high-20s, ROE above 20%, and a near-debt-free balance sheet. But the company is already an Rs 1,36,592 Cr mega-cap, which is the disqualifying factor here: this thesis screens for 10x-in-2-3-years or 100x-in-10-years outcomes, and a company already this large would need to become one of the largest listed companies in India within the window to satisfy either bar.
